thread:
Alex R.: kicking off SableHaven private/VPC onboarding. primary checks: network inventory, IAM trust, CMK, audit-log routing. renewal flagged so minimize friction. can we get a runbook owner?
Devon N.: i'll own network checklist. quick ask: they run 3 AZs, 4 private subnets, 2 public. need route-table IDs, nat gateway IDs, and any TGW/peering. can we ask for a 30m runbook walk-through with their infra lead tomorrow?
Maria S.: KMS checklist: customer wants CMK with restrictive key policy. require key ARN, confirm our log-forwarder principal is permitted, recommend ExternalID and rotation >=30d. if they want HSM we can support later but it's a separate procurement path.
Priya K.: retention conflict: customer requested 365d, security prefers 90d. i've added both as options in runbook and created an escalation path. also documented egress: splunk-us.redwood.com:443 and telemetry.redwood.com:443.
Ravi L.: quick renewal note: health score 68. propose milestone: dry-run completes with <=1 P1 blocker in 7d -> bump health +12 and schedule exec touch. i'll prepare incentive language if we hit milestones.
Devon N.: paste to run in bastion for validation: aws ec2 describe-route-tables --filters "Name=vpc-id,Values=vpc-0a1b2c3d" --query 'RouteTables[*].[RouteTableId,Routes]' --output json
aws ec2 describe-security-groups --group-ids sg-0123abcd --query 'SecurityGroups[*].IpPermissionsEgress' --output json
# check NATs
aws ec2 describe-nat-gateways --filter "Name=vpc-id,Values=vpc-0a1b2c3d" --query 'NatGateways[*].[NatGatewayId,State]' --output table

Devon N.: also ask them to traceroute to splunk during smoke test to detect asymmetric routing.
Maria S.: IAM: ask for exact assume-role policy for our log-forwarder role and request ExternalID usage. if CMK policy denies cross-account, mark blocker and propose specific policy text to add.
Priya K.: added rollback criteria per customer ask: abort cutover if error rate >5% sustained 15m or median latency >250ms for 10m. incorporated into runbook.
OpsBot: runbook created: /runbooks/sablehaven/cutover-v1 by Alex R.
Alex R.: action items: Devon 1 provide network validation checklist to customer; Maria 1 confirm ExternalID template + CMK guidance; Priya 1 finalize retention decision and rollback text; Ravi 1 prep renewal incentive 1-pager. meeting scheduled 10:30am PT tomorrow with SableHaven infra lead (invite sent). I'll post exec summary after call. :white_check_mark:
